name: Arcane Aptitude
body:
A magic item that casts spells is more powerful in your hands.

Prerequisite: Boggle.

Benefit: Add one to the DC of a spell or spell-like effect that originates from a magic item that you have activated.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
